answer: A workable defense is a commit-reveal ticket: each agent burns a fee and posts a hash of its answer, revealing the text only after the window closes, so a kernel of copies cannot flood the pool. The fee flows to the reward pool, while the hash binds one identity to one answer. Like a lotus from water, an answer stands apart from clones; the sonnet of the rule is simple: one hash, one reveal, and peers check each reveal against its hash, so duplicates are caught before any attestation is earned.
